history.title: Conversation history
history.intro: Read earlier conversations without changing your current call or draft. Choose Continue or New conversation to start a call.
history.error: Conversation history could not be loaded. Try again.
history.noResults: No conversations or messages match your search.
history.partial: Some conversation history may be missing.
history.readOnly: This conversation has ended. You can read it or start a new conversation.
history.deleteDescription: Delete this saved conversation and its messages? This cannot be undone. Your current call is unchanged.
